amount_text: $1B in Meta's equity offering (with NVIDIA's $3B, $4B combined)
title_en: AMD invests $1B in Meta's share offering
title_zh: AMD 向 Meta 股票发行投资 10 亿美元
summary_en: AMD said it will invest $1B in Meta's equity offering on the same day as NVIDIA's $3B, as part of Meta's ~$95B AI financing plan.
summary_zh: AMD 宣布将在 Meta 的股票发行中投资 10 亿美元，与英伟达的 30 亿美元同日公布，属于 Meta 约 950 亿美元 AI 融资计划的一部分。

amount_text: $3B in Meta's equity offering (part of Meta's ~$95B financing plan announced 26 Oct 2026)
title_en: NVIDIA invests $3B in Meta's share offering, expands Muse partnership
title_zh: 英伟达向 Meta 股票发行投资 30 亿美元，扩大 Muse 合作
summary_en: NVIDIA said it will invest $3B in Meta's equity offering, part of Meta's ~$95B AI financing plan, and the two will expand work on Meta's Muse models; Meta will widen its use of NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform and Vera CPUs.
summary_zh: 英伟达宣布将在 Meta 的股票发行中投资 30 亿美元（属于 Meta 约 950 亿美元的 AI 融资计划），双方扩大在 Muse 模型上的合作；Meta 将扩大使用英伟达 Vera Rubin 平台和 Vera CPU。

subkind: share offering (forward sale) and mandatory convertible preferred
amount_text: $25.0B Class A common (40M shares at $625, forward sale settling by Nov 2027) + $12.5B 6.50% Series A mandatory convertible preferred; up to ~$43.0B with underwriters' options; priced 2026-10-26
term: Preferred converts in Aug 2029; forward sale settles on or before 2027-11-19
title_en: Meta's $37.5B share and mandatory convertible offerings
title_zh: Meta 发行 375 亿美元普通股与强制可转换优先股
summary_en: Meta priced $25 billion of Class A common stock sold through forward sale agreements with Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs and $12.5 billion of 6.50% mandatory convertible preferred stock, to fund its AI build-out; Reuters described the wider plan as about $95 billion. NVIDIA ($3 billion) and AMD ($1 billion) said they would invest in the offering (separate edges).
summary_zh: Meta 定价发行 250 亿美元 A 类普通股（通过与摩根士丹利、高盛的远期出售协议）及 125 亿美元、股息率 6.50% 的强制可转换优先股，为 AI 基础设施建设融资；路透社称整体融资计划约 950 亿美元。英伟达（30 亿美元）和 AMD（10 亿美元）表示将参与认购（另列）。

amount_text: ~¥100B (reported as ~$14-15B) per Reuters and Bloomberg sources, upsized from ¥50B and ¥80B targets; DeepSeek, Tencent and CATL have not confirmed the terms, so the figure is a report, not a disclosure
title_en: DeepSeek raises ~¥100B (~$15B) led by Tencent and CATL (reported)
title_zh: DeepSeek 据报完成约 1000 亿元人民币（约 150 亿美元）融资，腾讯与宁德时代为最大投资方
summary_en: Reuters and Bloomberg reported that DeepSeek, until now funded only by its parent High-Flyer, completed its first outside round of about ¥100B, with Tencent and CATL as the largest investors at a pre-money valuation reported near ¥500B; the target had risen from ¥50B to ¥80B to ¥100B during October 2026, and CITIC Securities is reportedly preparing a STAR Market listing. None of the parties has commented, so the investors' individual amounts are not modelled.
summary_zh: 路透社和彭博报道，此前仅由母公司幻方量化出资的 DeepSeek 完成首轮外部融资约 1000 亿元人民币，腾讯和宁德时代为最大投资方，投前估值据报约 5000 亿元人民币；2026 年 10 月间融资目标由 500 亿元人民币升至 800 亿元再到 1000 亿元，据报中信证券正筹备其科创板上市。各方均未置评，因此未单独列出各投资方金额。

amount_text: $1B combined: $500M from Samsung Electronics and $500M from five affiliates
title_en: Samsung commits $1B to KKR-led Helix
title_zh: 三星向 KKR 牵头的 Helix 投资 10 亿美元
summary_en: Samsung Electronics and five affiliates agreed to invest a combined $1B in Helix Digital Infrastructure, the KKR-led AI infrastructure platform backed by Nvidia.
summary_zh: 三星电子及五家关联公司同意合计向 KKR 牵头、英伟达支持的 AI 基础设施平台 Helix 数字基础设施投资 10 亿美元（三星电子 5 亿美元，五家关联公司合计 5 亿美元）。

amount_text: ~$3B of equity per a person familiar with the terms (Reuters, 2026-09-24); not confirmed by Blue Owl
term: Oracle-leased campus in Doña Ana County, New Mexico
title_en: Blue Owl's ~$3B equity in Oracle's Project Jupiter campus
title_zh: Blue Owl 在甲骨文 Project Jupiter 园区约 30 亿美元股权投资
summary_en: Blue Owl, owner of developer STACK Infrastructure, has about $3B of equity in Project Jupiter, the AI campus in New Mexico built for Oracle and OpenAI. In September 2026 Oracle sent a force majeure notice over delays securing power; Blue Owl said the notice does not change the financial commitments.
summary_zh: 开发商 STACK Infrastructure 的母公司 Blue Owl 在新墨西哥州为甲骨文和 OpenAI 建设的 Project Jupiter AI 园区持有约 30 亿美元股权（知情人士透露，Blue Owl 未确认）。2026 年 9 月甲骨文因供电延误发出不可抗力通知；Blue Owl 称该通知不改变资金承诺。

amount_text: $3.9B anticipated Series F at a $30.9B post-money valuation; Crusoe announced the initial closing on 17 Sep 2026, so the final size may differ
title_en: Crusoe $3.9B Series F at a $30.9B valuation
title_zh: Crusoe 39 亿美元 F 轮融资，估值 309 亿美元
summary_en: Crusoe announced the initial closing of an anticipated $3.9B Series F at a $30.9B post-money valuation, co-led by Atreides Management, Mubadala Capital and Valor Equity Partners with Founders Fund, GIC, Nvidia, QIA, Radical Ventures and TPG, to fund large campuses such as Abilene, modular Crusoe Spark data centres and its cloud; it came ten months after a $1.38B round at a $10B valuation.
summary_zh: Crusoe 宣布完成预计 39 亿美元 F 轮融资的首次交割，投后估值 309 亿美元，由 Atreides Management、穆巴达拉资本和 Valor Equity Partners 联合领投，Founders Fund、GIC、英伟达、卡塔尔投资局、Radical Ventures 和 TPG 参投，资金用于阿比林等大型园区、模块化 Crusoe Spark 数据中心及其云业务；距上一轮 13.8 亿美元、估值 100 亿美元的融资仅十个月。

amount_text: $19.9B net proceeds from at-the-market common stock issuance in the quarter ended 31 Aug 2026 (per 10-Q); programme size not checked; announced date is the 10-Q filing
title_en: Oracle raises $19.9B of new equity through an at-the-market programme
title_zh: 甲骨文通过按市价发行计划募集 199 亿美元股本
summary_en: Oracle's 10-Q for the quarter ended 31 August 2026 shows about $19.9B of net proceeds from common stock issued through its at-the-market programme, as it funds AI data-centre buildout.
summary_zh: 甲骨文截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日的季度报告显示，通过按市价发行（ATM）计划发行普通股，净募资约 199 亿美元，用于 AI 数据中心建设。

amount_text: €3B (~$3.5B per Crunchbase) at >€21B post-money; led by Samsung Electronics, co-led by EQT's Scaleup Europe Fund and PSG Equity
title_en: Mistral AI raises €3B Series D led by Samsung
title_zh: Mistral AI 完成三星领投的 30 亿欧元 D 轮
summary_en: Mistral AI raised €3B in a Series D at a post-money valuation above €21B, led by Samsung Electronics with EQT's Scaleup Europe Fund and PSG Equity as co-leads.
summary_zh: Mistral AI 完成 30 亿欧元 D 轮融资，投后估值超过 210 亿欧元，由三星电子领投、EQT 管理的 Scaleup Europe Fund 与 PSG Equity 联合领投。

amount_text: Undisclosed share of the €3B Series D (round total is a separate edge)
title_en: Samsung leads Mistral AI's Series D
title_zh: 三星领投 Mistral AI D 轮
summary_en: Samsung Electronics was lead investor in Mistral AI's €3B Series D; its individual amount was not disclosed.
summary_zh: 三星电子领投 Mistral AI 30 亿欧元 D 轮，具体金额未披露。

amount_text: $12.9B: about $11.9B to Hugging Face investors plus up to $1B of stock incentives for staff (as reported); pending regulatory review
title_en: NVIDIA acquisition of Hugging Face
title_zh: 英伟达收购 Hugging Face
summary_en: After The Information reported the deal in late August 2026, Nvidia confirmed it is buying the AI model platform Hugging Face for $12.9B, roughly $11.9B to investors plus up to $1B in stock incentives for employees. In late October Reuters reported that the US Justice Department is asking questions about the deal.
summary_zh: The Information 于 2026 年 8 月下旬率先报道后，英伟达确认以 129 亿美元收购 AI 模型平台 Hugging Face，其中约 119 亿美元支付给投资者，另有最多 10 亿美元股票激励给员工。10 月下旬路透社报道美国司法部正在就该交易进行问询。

amount_text: $1.5B led by Jane Street at a valuation above $18B (Forbes, citing sources; not announced by the company)
title_en: Fluidstack raises $1.5B led by Jane Street at $18B+
title_zh: Fluidstack 获 Jane Street 领投 15 亿美元融资，估值逾 180 亿美元
summary_en: Forbes reported that Fluidstack closed a $1.5B round led by quant firm Jane Street at a valuation above $18B, more than double its $7.5B mark earlier in 2026; Bloomberg had reported talks in April.
summary_zh: 据《福布斯》报道，Fluidstack 完成由量化机构 Jane Street 领投的 15 亿美元融资，估值逾 180 亿美元，较 2026 年早些时候的 75 亿美元翻倍有余；彭博社曾于 4 月报道相关谈判。

amount_text: HK$80.0B gross (~$10.2B), net ~HK$79.7B: 710,000,000 new shares at HK$112.70, announced 23-24 Aug 2026 and completed 26 Aug 2026; 100% of net proceeds for AI (~60% global computing infrastructure, ~40% hyperscale AI data centres and cloud upgrades)
title_en: Alibaba raises HK$80B (~$10.2B) in share placement for AI
title_zh: 阿里巴巴配售新股募资 800 亿港元（约 102 亿美元）投入 AI
summary_en: Alibaba placed 710 million new Hong Kong shares at HK$112.70 to non-US investors, its first placement since its 2019 Hong Kong listing and the largest on the exchange, raising HK$80B; it said all net proceeds go to full-stack AI, about 60% to global computing infrastructure and 40% to hyperscale AI data centres and cloud upgrades. The shares fell about 10% on the pricing; the placing closed on 26 August 2026.
summary_zh: 阿里巴巴以每股 112.70 港元向非美国投资者配售 7.1 亿股新股，是其 2019 年港股上市以来首次配股，也是港交所最大规模配售，募资 800 亿港元；公司称全部净额用于全栈 AI，约六成投向全球算力基础设施，约四成用于超大规模 AI 数据中心和云升级。定价后股价下跌约 10%；配售于 2026 年 8 月 26 日完成。

amount_text: $20B: 210,526,315 shares at $95 (upsized from $15B); underwriters' option for 31.6M more shares
title_en: Intel raises $20B in upsized share sale
title_zh: 英特尔增发股票募资 200 亿美元
summary_en: Intel priced $20B of new common stock at $95 a share, upsized from $15B; the offering was expected to close on 12 August 2026.
summary_zh: 英特尔以每股 95 美元定价增发 200 亿美元新股（原计划 150 亿美元），预计 2026 年 8 月 12 日交割。

amount_text: US$2B (~A$2.8B) equity at a post-money valuation above US$10.5B; Coatue and NVIDIA (follow-on), Blackstone-managed funds and Jane Street (new); individual amounts undisclosed
title_en: Firmus raises $2B equity at $10.5B+ valuation
title_zh: Firmus 完成 20 亿美元股权融资，估值逾 105 亿美元
summary_en: Australian AI-factory builder Firmus raised US$2B of equity from Coatue, NVIDIA, Blackstone funds and Jane Street, valuing it above US$10.5B, to build Project Southgate in Australia and expand across Asia-Pacific; it follows a US$10B Blackstone-led debt facility in February.
summary_zh: 澳大利亚 AI 工厂建设商 Firmus 从 Coatue、英伟达、黑石旗下基金和 Jane Street 获得 20 亿美元股权融资，投后估值逾 105 亿美元，用于建设澳大利亚 Project Southgate 并向亚太扩张；此前 2 月已获黑石牵头的 100 亿美元债务融资。

amount_text: $3.5B at $35B post-money; National AI Industry Investment Fund among leads; Alibaba participated
title_en: Moonshot AI raises $3.5B at $35B valuation
title_zh: 月之暗面以 350 亿美元估值融资 35 亿美元
summary_en: Moonshot AI reportedly raised $3.5B, well above its $1-2B target, at a $35B valuation after its Kimi K3 model; China's state-backed National AI Industry Investment Fund was among the leads and existing investors including Alibaba took part. Moonshot did not comment.
summary_zh: 据报道，月之暗面凭借 Kimi K3 模型融资 35 亿美元，远超 10-20 亿美元的目标，估值 350 亿美元；国家人工智能产业投资基金为领投方之一，阿里巴巴等老股东参与。月之暗面未置评。

amount_text: $1B strategic equity investment; its precondition (the Brookfield financing) was met on 2026-10-27; share issuance pending, after which Nvidia becomes Naver's third-largest shareholder
title_en: Nvidia to invest $1B in Naver's AI factory buildout
title_zh: 英伟达拟为 NAVER 的 AI 工厂建设投资 10 亿美元
summary_en: In the joint release with Brookfield, Nvidia said it will invest $1B in Naver toward the roughly $10B expansion of Naver's GAK Sejong AI factory from 55 MW to 200 MW. Naver's signing of the Brookfield deal on 27 October 2026 met the condition for the investment; once the new shares are issued Nvidia becomes Naver's third-largest shareholder.
summary_zh: 在与布鲁克菲尔德的联合新闻稿中，英伟达表示将向 NAVER 投资 10 亿美元，用于 NAVER 世宗 GAK AI 工厂从 55 兆瓦扩建至 200 兆瓦（总投资约 100 亿美元）。NAVER 于 2026 年 10 月 27 日与布鲁克菲尔德签约，满足了这笔投资的前提条件；新股发行后英伟达将成为 NAVER 第三大股东。

amount_text: Up to $5.0B of Anthropic Class N common stock, which Anthropic can draw in increments as AMD GPU delivery and deployment milestones are met (first milestone expected in 2027); after the IPO priced at the 30-day average share price (Anthropic S-1)
title_en: AMD to invest up to $5B in Anthropic
title_zh: AMD 向 Anthropic 投资最多 50 亿美元
summary_en: Under the July 2026 hardware supply agreement, AMD committed to buy up to $5B of Anthropic's Class N common stock, available to Anthropic in steps as AMD GPU capacity is delivered and deployed, the first expected in 2027 (Anthropic S-1). A circular structure: the chip supplier funds its customer.
summary_zh: 根据 2026 年 7 月的硬件供应协议，AMD 承诺购买最多 50 亿美元的 Anthropic N 类普通股，Anthropic 可随 AMD GPU 交付和部署里程碑分步提取，首个里程碑预计在 2027 年达成（Anthropic S-1）。这是芯片供应商出资支持客户的循环结构。

amount_text: $830M Series A at a $7.5B valuation, led by Situational Awareness; closed January 2026, announced 20 July 2026
title_en: Fluidstack raises $830M Series A at $7.5B
title_zh: Fluidstack 完成 8.3 亿美元 A 轮融资，估值 75 亿美元
summary_en: Fluidstack, which builds AI data centres for Anthropic and Google-backed sites, said it raised $830M in a Series A led by Situational Awareness at a $7.5B valuation; the round closed in January 2026.
summary_zh: 为 Anthropic 及谷歌兜底项目建设 AI 数据中心的 Fluidstack 宣布完成由 Situational Awareness 领投的 8.3 亿美元 A 轮融资，估值 75 亿美元，该轮已于 2026 年 1 月完成。

amount_text: HK$9.54B gross (~US$1.22B at ~HK$7.8/US$): 35.6M new Class A shares at HK$268; issued with HK$6.5B (~US$0.83B) zero-coupon convertible bonds due 2027, ~HK$16B in total
title_en: MiniMax share placement
title_zh: MiniMax 配售新股
summary_en: MiniMax placed 35.6 million new shares with at least six independent investors at HK$268 each, raising about HK$9.54B, alongside HK$6.5B of zero-coupon convertible bonds due 2027 (about HK$16B in all, through Morgan Stanley and UBS). The money goes to AI infrastructure, model R&D and its global rollout.
summary_zh: MiniMax 以每股 268 港元向不少于六名独立投资者配售 3,560 万股新股，募资约 95.4 亿港元，同时发行 65 亿港元 2027 年到期零息可转债（合计约 160 亿港元，由摩根士丹利和瑞银承办）。资金用于 AI 基础设施、模型研发和全球推广。

subkind: US listing of new shares (Nasdaq ADS offering)
amount_text: US$26.5B: 177.9M ADS at $149 (each ADS = one-tenth of a common share)
title_en: SK hynix raises $26.5B in record US listing
title_zh: SK 海力士赴美上市募资 265 亿美元，创纪录
summary_en: SK hynix sold 177.9 million American depositary shares at $149 for its Nasdaq listing (ticker SKHY), raising about $26.5B; settlement was expected around 14 July 2026.
summary_zh: SK 海力士以每份 149 美元发行 1.779 亿份美国存托股（ADS）并在纳斯达克上市（代码 SKHY），募资约 265 亿美元；预计 2026 年 7 月 14 日前后交割。

amount_text: ~$530M for TeraWulf's entire 50.1% stake in the Abernathy JV (FS CS I LLC), paid by Fluidstack and other purchasers in three instalments ($250M, $150M by 2026-12-31, ~$130M by 2027-04-30)
title_en: Fluidstack and partners buy TeraWulf's Abernathy JV stake (~$530M)
title_zh: Fluidstack 等买方收购 TeraWulf 所持 Abernathy 合资股权（约 5.3 亿美元）
summary_en: TeraWulf agreed to sell its entire 50.1% stake in the Abernathy, Texas joint venture to Fluidstack and other purchasers for about $530 million, paid in instalments through April 2027, leaving Fluidstack's side in control of the 168 MW campus; TeraWulf said it will redeploy the cash into wholly owned sites.
summary_zh: TeraWulf 同意以约 5.3 亿美元将其所持得州 Abernathy 合资公司 50.1% 股权全部出售给 Fluidstack 及其他买方，分期支付至 2027 年 4 月，此后 168 兆瓦园区由 Fluidstack 一方控制；TeraWulf 称将把资金投入全资项目。

amount_text: >$10B committed in total by founding investors KKR, Kuwait Investment Authority, Nvidia and Vistra (split undisclosed)
title_en: KKR launches Helix AI infrastructure platform with $10B+
title_zh: KKR 以逾 100 亿美元启动 Helix AI 基础设施平台
summary_en: KKR launched Helix Digital Infrastructure, led by former AWS CEO Adam Selipsky, with more than $10B committed by KKR, the Kuwait Investment Authority, Nvidia (technology partner) and Vistra (preferred power provider) to build data centres, power and fibre.
summary_zh: KKR 启动由前 AWS 首席执行官 Adam Selipsky 领导的 Helix 数字基础设施，KKR、科威特投资局、英伟达（技术伙伴）和 Vistra（首选电力供应商）承诺逾 100 亿美元，用于建设数据中心、电力和光纤。

amount_text: $85.7B total IPO proceeds: 555,555,555 Class A shares at $135 (~$75B, priced 11 Jun 2026) plus the 83.3M-share over-allotment option exercised in full (~638.9M shares in all; SpaceX, 15 Jun 2026)
title_en: SpaceX raises $85.7B in record IPO
title_zh: SpaceX 完成创纪录 IPO，募资 857 亿美元
summary_en: SpaceX, which absorbed xAI in February 2026, sold 555.6 million Class A shares at $135 in the largest IPO on record and listed on Nasdaq as SPCX on 12 June 2026; underwriters led by Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley exercised the 83.3 million-share over-allotment in full, lifting total proceeds to $85.7B. The cash funds, among other things, the xAI/Colossus compute build-out rented to Anthropic and Google.
summary_zh: 2026 年 2 月合并 xAI 后的 SpaceX 以每股 135 美元发行 5.556 亿股 A 类股，完成史上最大 IPO，6 月 12 日以 SPCX 代码在纳斯达克上市；由高盛和摩根士丹利牵头的承销商全额行使 8330 万股超额配售选择权，使总募资额增至 857 亿美元。资金用途包括向 Anthropic 和谷歌出租算力的 xAI/Colossus 算力建设。

subkind: public equity offering (common stock + mandatory convertible preferred)
amount_text: ~$39.95B gross: $18.0B of Class A and Class C stock at $355.20 / $351.80 plus $2.7B over-allotment (exercised) = $20.7B; and two series of 6.25% mandatory convertible preferred (Series A and B, 192.5M depositary shares each at $50 incl. options) = $19.25B, converting around May 2029. Berkshire Hathaway's $10B private placement is a separate edge; the $40B at-the-market programme is not counted
title_en: Alphabet raises ~$40B in stock and mandatory convertibles
title_zh: Alphabet 通过股票和强制可转换优先股募资约 400 亿美元
summary_en: Alphabet sold about $20.7B of Class A and Class C shares and $19.25B of 6.25% mandatory convertible preferred stock (offerings upsized and over-allotments exercised in full), to fund capital spending on AI infrastructure and compute. With Berkshire Hathaway's $10B private placement and a $40B at-the-market programme, Alphabet put the whole package at $84.75B.
summary_zh: Alphabet 发行约 207 亿美元 A 类和 C 类股票，以及 192.5 亿美元、股息率 6.25% 的强制可转换优先股（发行规模上调，超额配售全额行使），用于 AI 基础设施和算力投资。加上伯克希尔·哈撒韦的 100 亿美元私募和 400 亿美元按市价发行计划，Alphabet 称整套融资合计 847.5 亿美元。

amount_text: $10B: $5B of Class A stock at ~$351.81 and $5B of Class C stock at ~$348.20 (about 28.6M shares)
title_en: Berkshire Hathaway buys $10B of Alphabet stock
title_zh: 伯克希尔·哈撒韦认购 100 亿美元 Alphabet 股票
summary_en: An affiliate of Berkshire Hathaway agreed on 1 June 2026 to buy $10B of newly issued Alphabet Class A and Class C shares in a private placement, part of Alphabet's equity raise to fund AI infrastructure.
summary_zh: 伯克希尔·哈撒韦旗下公司于 2026 年 6 月 1 日同意以私募方式认购 100 亿美元 Alphabet 新发行的 A 类和 C 类股票，属于 Alphabet 为 AI 基础设施进行的股权融资的一部分。

to_name: Campus AI (MGX, Bpifrance, Mistral AI, NVIDIA JV in France)
amount_text: Amount not confirmed; MGX share undisclosed
term: network of up to 3 GW across France
title_en: MGX, Bpifrance and Mistral expand Campus AI with a second French site
title_zh: MGX、Bpifrance 与 Mistral 为法国 AI 园区增建第二个站点
summary_en: Bpifrance, Mistral AI and MGX announced a second Campus AI site, growing the network toward 3 GW of AI compute across France.
summary_zh: Bpifrance、Mistral AI 和 MGX 宣布法国 AI 园区第二个站点，使该网络在法国的 AI 算力目标扩大至 3 吉瓦。

amount_text: Undisclosed; part of the $65B Series H, whose total is counted on the round's own edge
title_en: Micron invests in Anthropic's Series H
title_zh: 美光参投 Anthropic H 轮融资
summary_en: Micron joined Anthropic's $65B Series H (28 May 2026) as a strategic infrastructure partner, alongside Samsung and SK hynix; Anthropic said their memory, storage and logic chips are critical to scaling its compute. The amount was not disclosed.
summary_zh: 美光与三星和 SK 海力士一同作为战略基础设施合作伙伴参投 Anthropic 650 亿美元 H 轮融资（2026 年 5 月 28 日）；Anthropic 表示其存储与逻辑芯片对扩充算力至关重要。金额未披露。

amount_text: $65.2B gross at $589.01 a share ($965B post-money): ~$45.7B of voting Series H-1 from 305 investors + ~$19.5B of non-voting Series H-2 from 11 investors, which includes $10B from Google and $5B from Amazon already counted on their edges; ~$50.2B from other investors counted here (Anthropic S-1)
title_en: Anthropic $65B Series H at $965B
title_zh: Anthropic 650 亿美元 H 轮融资（估值 9650 亿美元）
summary_en: Anthropic raised $65.2B in May-June 2026 led by Altimeter, Dragoneer, Greenoaks and Sequoia at a $965B post-money valuation; per its S-1, $45.7B came as voting Series H-1 shares from 305 investors and $19.5B as non-voting Series H-2 shares, including $10B from Google and $5B from Amazon. Micron, Samsung and SK hynix joined as strategic investors.
summary_zh: Anthropic 于 2026 年 5-6 月完成 652 亿美元 H 轮融资，由 Altimeter、Dragoneer、Greenoaks 和红杉领投，投后估值 9650 亿美元；据 S-1，其中 457 亿美元为 305 名投资者认购的有投票权 H-1 优先股，195 亿美元为无投票权 H-2 优先股（含谷歌 100 亿美元、亚马逊 50 亿美元）。美光、三星和 SK 海力士作为战略投资者参投。

amount_text: Undisclosed; part of the $65B Series H, whose total is counted on the round's own edge
title_en: Samsung Electronics invests in Anthropic's Series H
title_zh: 三星电子参投 Anthropic H 轮融资
summary_en: Samsung Electronics joined Anthropic's $65B Series H (28 May 2026) as a strategic infrastructure partner, alongside Micron and SK hynix; Anthropic said their memory, storage and logic chips are critical to scaling its compute. The amount was not disclosed.
summary_zh: 三星电子与美光和 SK 海力士一同作为战略基础设施合作伙伴参投 Anthropic 650 亿美元 H 轮融资（2026 年 5 月 28 日）；Anthropic 表示其存储与逻辑芯片对扩充算力至关重要。金额未披露。

amount_text: Undisclosed; part of the $65B Series H, whose total is counted on the round's own edge
title_en: SK hynix invests in Anthropic's Series H
title_zh: SK 海力士参投 Anthropic H 轮融资
summary_en: SK hynix joined Anthropic's $65B Series H (28 May 2026) as a strategic infrastructure partner, alongside Micron and Samsung; Anthropic said their memory, storage and logic chips are critical to scaling its compute. The amount was not disclosed.
summary_zh: SK 海力士与美光和三星一同作为战略基础设施合作伙伴参投 Anthropic 650 亿美元 H 轮融资（2026 年 5 月 28 日）；Anthropic 表示其存储与逻辑芯片对扩充算力至关重要。金额未披露。

amount_text: $5B initial equity from Blackstone; Google supplies TPUs, software and services; up to ~$25B including leverage (Reuters, per Data Center Knowledge)
title_en: Blackstone commits $5B to Crux AI, its TPU cloud with Google
title_zh: 黑石向与谷歌合办的 TPU 云 Crux AI 注资 50 亿美元
summary_en: Blackstone committed an initial $5B of equity to a TPU cloud venture with Google that rents out Google TPUs as compute-as-a-service, aiming for 500 MW of capacity in 2027; Google veteran Benjamin Treynor Sloss is CEO.
summary_zh: 黑石承诺首期 50 亿美元股权，与谷歌合办出租谷歌 TPU 算力的云业务，目标在 2027 年上线 500 兆瓦，由谷歌资深基础设施高管 Benjamin Treynor Sloss 任首席执行官。

amount_text: $5.55B: 30,000,000 Class A shares at $185 (priced 13 May 2026, above the $150-160 range); underwriters' 30-day option on 4,500,000 more shares
title_en: Cerebras raises $5.55B in Nasdaq IPO (CBRS)
title_zh: Cerebras 纳斯达克 IPO 募资 55.5 亿美元（代码 CBRS）
summary_en: Cerebras sold 30 million Class A shares at $185, above its $150-160 range, for a fully diluted valuation of about $56B, and began trading on Nasdaq as CBRS on 14 May 2026, closing its first day at $311. OpenAI, its largest customer (own edges), holds a warrant over its shares.
summary_zh: Cerebras 以每股 185 美元（高于 150–160 美元区间）发行 3000 万股 A 类股，完全摊薄估值约 560 亿美元，于 2026 年 5 月 14 日以 CBRS 代码在纳斯达克上市，首日收于 311 美元。其最大客户 OpenAI（另有边）持有其认股权证。

subkind: investment rights (warrants) tied to GPU deliveries
amount_text: Up to ~$2.1B: rights to buy 30M IREN shares at $70, vesting in tranches as IREN takes delivery of up to 600,000 NVIDIA GPUs; exercisable to 7 May 2031
title_en: NVIDIA can invest up to $2.1B in IREN
title_zh: 英伟达可向 IREN 投资最多 21 亿美元
summary_en: NVIDIA bought rights to purchase 30M IREN shares at $70 each (up to about $2.1B), vesting as IREN deploys up to 600,000 NVIDIA GPUs, a circular deal alongside NVIDIA's $3.4B cloud contract with IREN.
summary_zh: 英伟达购入以每股 70 美元认购 3000 万股 IREN 股票的权利（最多约 21 亿美元），随 IREN 部署最多 60 万块英伟达 GPU 分批生效；与英伟达同 IREN 的 34 亿美元云合同构成循环交易。

amount_text: ~$2B at $20B+ valuation; led by Meituan's Long-Z Investments
title_en: Moonshot AI raises $2B at $20B valuation
title_zh: 月之暗面以 200 亿美元估值融资 20 亿美元
summary_en: Moonshot AI raised about $2B at a valuation above $20B in a round led by Meituan's Long-Z Investments, with China Mobile and CPE among the participants.
summary_zh: 月之暗面以超过 200 亿美元估值融资约 20 亿美元，由美团旗下龙珠投资领投，中国移动和源峰等参与。

amount_text: Up to $40B: $10B of Series G-2 preferred at $259.14 a share (~$350B valuation) + up to $30B of convertible notes or non-voting stock under the March 2026 note purchase agreement through 2030, tied to compute-agreement conditions and revenue targets; $10B of that went into the May 2026 Series H, leaving $20B available at 30 June 2026 (Anthropic S-1)
title_en: Google to invest up to $40B in Anthropic
title_zh: 谷歌向 Anthropic 投资最多 400 亿美元
summary_en: Google bought $10B of Anthropic preferred stock at a $350B valuation and agreed to provide up to $30B more in convertible notes or non-voting stock through 2030 if conditions under compute agreements and revenue targets are met. Anthropic's S-1 shows $10B of that facility was used in the May 2026 Series H, leaving $20B; Google may instead buy up to $10B of stock alongside the IPO, which would reduce the facility by the same amount.
summary_zh: 谷歌以 3500 亿美元估值购入 100 亿美元 Anthropic 优先股，并同意在 2030 年前、视算力协议条件和营收目标达成情况，再以可转换票据或无投票权股票提供最多 300 亿美元。Anthropic 的 S-1 显示，其中 100 亿美元已用于 2026 年 5 月的 H 轮融资，剩余 200 亿美元；谷歌也可在 IPO 时同步认购最多 100 亿美元股票，届时该额度相应减少。

amount_text: Up to $25B: $5B of Series G-2 preferred (Q2 2026) + up to $20B under the 2026 note purchase agreement (non-voting stock or convertible notes), released in $5B tranches tied to compute-capacity milestones; $5B of it went into the May 2026 Series H, leaving $15B available at 30 June 2026 (Anthropic S-1). Separate from ~$6.2B of older Amazon rollover notes
title_en: Amazon to invest up to $25B more in Anthropic
title_zh: 亚马逊再向 Anthropic 投资最多 250 亿美元
summary_en: Amazon agreed to invest $5B in Anthropic immediately and up to $20B more tied to compute-capacity milestones, on top of its earlier $8B, as Anthropic committed to AWS. Anthropic's S-1 shows the $5B was paid for preferred stock in the second quarter of 2026 and a further $5B from the milestone facility went into the May 2026 Series H, leaving $15B available.
summary_zh: 亚马逊同意立即向 Anthropic 投资 50 亿美元，并视算力容量里程碑再投最多 200 亿美元（此前已投 80 亿美元），同时 Anthropic 向 AWS 作出采购承诺。Anthropic 的 S-1 显示，这 50 亿美元已于 2026 年第二季度用于认购优先股，里程碑额度中另有 50 亿美元投入 2026 年 5 月的 H 轮融资，剩余 150 亿美元可用。

amount_text: $1.0B: 9,174,311 Class A shares at $109.00 (about 7% below the prior close)
title_en: Jane Street invests $1B in CoreWeave
title_zh: Jane Street 向 CoreWeave 投资 10 亿美元
summary_en: Jane Street bought $1B of newly issued CoreWeave Class A shares at $109 in a private placement on 15 April 2026, alongside its $6B cloud contract, lifting its stake to about $1.44B.
summary_zh: Jane Street 于 2026 年 4 月 15 日以每股 109 美元私募认购 10 亿美元 CoreWeave 新发行 A 类股，同时签订 60 亿美元云合同，持股市值增至约 14.4 亿美元。

amount_text: US$505M at ~US$5.5B valuation, led by Coatue with NVIDIA participating
title_en: Firmus raises $505M led by Coatue
title_zh: Firmus 获 Coatue 领投 5.05 亿美元融资
summary_en: Nvidia-backed Firmus raised US$505M in a round led by Coatue at about a US$5.5B valuation to expand its Project Southgate AI factories in Australia.
summary_zh: 英伟达支持的 Firmus 完成由 Coatue 领投的 5.05 亿美元融资，估值约 55 亿美元，用于扩建其在澳大利亚的 Project Southgate AI 工厂。

amount_text: ~$12B beyond the $110B first close (round total $122B at $852B post-money), incl. ~$3B from individuals via bank channels
title_en: OpenAI extends its round by ~$12B to $122B
title_zh: OpenAI 融资轮追加约 120 亿美元至 1220 亿美元
summary_en: After the $110B first close with Amazon, Nvidia and SoftBank, OpenAI took roughly $12B more from a wider investor pool including a16z, D. E. Shaw, MGX, TPG and T. Rowe Price-advised accounts, plus about $3B from individuals through banks, closing at $122B and an $852B post-money valuation.
summary_zh: 在亚马逊、英伟达和软银参与的 1100 亿美元首轮之后，OpenAI 又从 a16z、D. E. Shaw、MGX、TPG 及普信旗下账户等更广泛的投资者处募得约 120 亿美元，另通过银行渠道向个人投资者募资约 30 亿美元，最终以 1220 亿美元、投后估值 8520 亿美元完成该轮融资。

amount_text: ~$2B via pre-funded warrants for 21.07M shares; Nvidia stake 9.3% (Jul 2026 filing)
title_en: Nvidia invests $2B in Nebius
title_zh: 英伟达向 Nebius 投资 20 亿美元
summary_en: Nvidia invested about $2B in Nebius through pre-funded warrants, and Nebius gets early access to Rubin GPUs and Vera CPUs as it targets more than 5 GW of Nvidia capacity by 2030. A July 2026 filing showed Nvidia holding 9.3%.
summary_zh: 英伟达通过预付认股权证向 Nebius 投资约 20 亿美元，Nebius 获得 Rubin GPU 和 Vera CPU 优先供货，目标 2030 年前建成逾 5 吉瓦英伟达算力。2026 年 7 月的文件显示英伟达持股 9.3%。

amount_text: $50B committed: $15B upfront + $35B conditional (deadline 2028-12-31); $28.7B funded by 2026-06-30 per 10-Q
title_en: Amazon invests $50B in OpenAI
title_zh: 亚马逊向 OpenAI 投资 500 亿美元
summary_en: Amazon committed $50B to OpenAI's round, $15B upfront and $35B on conditions tied to the AWS partnership (deadline 31 December 2028). Amazon's 10-Q shows $28.7B funded by 30 June 2026.
summary_zh: 亚马逊承诺向 OpenAI 投资 500 亿美元，其中 150 亿美元先行到位，其余 350 亿美元附带与 AWS 合作挂钩的条件（截止日期为 2028 年 12 月 31 日）。亚马逊 10-Q 显示，截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日已出资 287 亿美元。

amount_text: $30B in OpenAI's $122B round (closed 31 Mar 2026, $852B post-money)
title_en: Nvidia invests $30B in OpenAI
title_zh: 英伟达向 OpenAI 投资 300 亿美元
summary_en: Nvidia put $30B into OpenAI's record round alongside Amazon and SoftBank, replacing the earlier $100B letter of intent; unlike that plan, the money is not tied to deployment milestones. The round closed on 31 March 2026 at $122B.
summary_zh: 英伟达与亚马逊、软银一同参与 OpenAI 创纪录融资，投资 300 亿美元，取代此前 1000 亿美元的意向书，且不再与算力部署里程碑挂钩。该轮融资于 2026 年 3 月 31 日以 1220 亿美元完成交割。

amount_text: $30B, paid in instalments during 2026 (SoftBank's Sept 2026 bonds fund its next $10B payment); cumulative SoftBank investment ~$64.6B (~13%)
title_en: SoftBank invests a further $30B in OpenAI
title_zh: 软银再向 OpenAI 投资 300 亿美元
summary_en: SoftBank co-led OpenAI's $122B round with $30B, initially financed with bridge loans, lifting its cumulative investment to about $64.6B or roughly 13% of the company.
summary_zh: 软银以 300 亿美元联合领投 OpenAI 1220 亿美元融资，初期以过桥贷款筹资，累计投资增至约 646 亿美元，持股约 13%。

amount_text: Performance warrant for up to 160M AMD shares (~10%), vesting with GW shipped and share-price thresholds
term: Vests from first 1 GW to 6 GW
title_en: AMD grants Meta warrant for up to 160M shares
title_zh: AMD 向 Meta 授予最多 1.6 亿股认股权证
summary_en: Mirroring its OpenAI deal, AMD issued Meta a performance warrant for up to 160 million shares that vests with GPU shipments from 1 GW to 6 GW and with AMD share-price targets reported to reach $600.
summary_zh: 与 OpenAI 协议如出一辙，AMD 向 Meta 发行最多 1.6 亿股的业绩认股权证，随 GPU 出货从 1 吉瓦增至 6 吉瓦及 AMD 股价目标（据报道最高 600 美元）分批归属。

amount_text: Undisclosed share of the $30B Series G (round total is a separate edge)
title_en: MGX co-leads Anthropic's Series G
title_zh: MGX 联合领投 Anthropic G 轮
summary_en: MGX was a co-lead, with D. E. Shaw, Dragoneer, Founders Fund and ICONIQ, of Anthropic's $30B Series G led by GIC and Coatue at a $380B post-money valuation.
summary_zh: Anthropic 300 亿美元 G 轮融资由 GIC 和 Coatue 领投，投后估值 3800 亿美元；MGX 与 D. E. Shaw、Dragoneer、Founders Fund、ICONIQ 为联合领投方。

amount_text: $30.2B gross in Q1 2026 at $259.14 a share ($380B post-money): ~$23.45B of voting Series G-1 from 261 investors (counted here) + ~$6.7B of non-voting Series G-2 from strategic investors the S-1 does not name (not counted; reports said the round included part of Microsoft's and NVIDIA's commitments, which have their own edges). Google's $10B and Amazon's $5B of Series G-2 in Q2 are on their own edges
title_en: Anthropic $30B Series G at $380B
title_zh: Anthropic 300 亿美元 G 轮融资（估值 3800 亿美元）
summary_en: Anthropic raised $30B led by GIC and Coatue at a $380B post-money valuation. Its S-1 shows $23.45B of voting Series G-1 shares sold to 261 investors in January-February 2026 and about $6.7B of non-voting Series G-2 shares to strategic investors; reports said the round included part of the Microsoft and NVIDIA investments.
summary_zh: Anthropic 完成 300 亿美元 G 轮融资，由 GIC 与 Coatue 领投，投后估值 3800 亿美元。S-1 显示，2026 年 1-2 月向 261 名投资者出售了 234.5 亿美元有投票权的 G-1 优先股，另向战略投资者出售约 67 亿美元无投票权 G-2 优先股；报道称本轮包含微软和英伟达投资的一部分。

amount_text: 100M depositary shares of 6.50% Series D mandatory convertible preferred (~$5B at $50 per depositary share); closed 5 Feb 2026
title_en: Oracle raises $5B with mandatory convertible preferred stock
title_zh: 甲骨文发行 50 亿美元强制可转换优先股
summary_en: Oracle sold 100 million depositary shares of 6.50% Series D mandatory convertible preferred stock (underwriting agreement 2 Feb, closed 5 Feb 2026), part of its 2026 debt-and-equity funding plan for AI data centres.
summary_zh: 甲骨文发行 1 亿份存托股，对应股息率 6.50% 的 D 系列强制可转换优先股（2 月 2 日签署承销协议，2026 年 2 月 5 日交割），为其 2026 年 AI 数据中心债务加股权融资计划的一部分。

amount_text: Not counted: all-stock merger, no cash changed hands; xAI valued at ~$250B and SpaceX at ~$1T (combined ~$1.25T, reported) — the figure is the valuation of xAI equity exchanged
title_en: SpaceX acquires xAI
title_zh: SpaceX 收购 xAI
summary_en: SpaceX acquired Elon Musk's xAI, making it a wholly owned subsidiary in a deal that reportedly valued xAI at $250B and SpaceX at $1T, ahead of SpaceX's planned IPO. xAI's Colossus data centres now rent compute to Anthropic and Google. The $250B is a valuation in an all-stock exchange, not cash, so no amount is counted.
summary_zh: SpaceX 收购马斯克旗下 xAI，使其成为全资子公司；据报道该交易对 xAI 估值 2500 亿美元、SpaceX 估值 1 万亿美元，为 SpaceX 计划中的上市铺路。xAI 的 Colossus 数据中心现向 Anthropic 和谷歌出租算力。 2500 亿美元是全股票换股中的估值而非现金，因此不计入金额。

amount_text: ~$2B, inside the $20B Series E counted on private-investors-xai-2026-01-series-e; converted into SpaceX common stock (under 1%) in March 2026 after the xAI–SpaceX merger, carried at $2.00B cost per Tesla's 10-Q
title_en: Tesla invests about $2B in xAI
title_zh: 特斯拉向 xAI 投资约 20 亿美元
summary_en: Tesla disclosed in its Q4 2025 shareholder letter a roughly $2B investment in xAI's Series E preferred stock, with a framework agreement for AI collaboration. After xAI merged into SpaceX on 2 February 2026, Tesla's stake converted in March 2026 into SpaceX common stock representing under 1% of SpaceX, which Tesla's 10-Q carries as a $2.00B equity-method investment (about $2.9B at the end of September 2026). It is part of the Series E, so it is not counted again in the round total.
summary_zh: 特斯拉在 2025 年第四季度股东信中披露向 xAI E 轮优先股投资约 20 亿美元，并签署 AI 合作框架协议。xAI 于 2026 年 2 月 2 日并入 SpaceX 后，特斯拉所持股份于 2026 年 3 月转换为 SpaceX 普通股（持股不足 1%），特斯拉 10-Q 以 20.0 亿美元权益法投资列示（2026 年 9 月底约 29 亿美元）。该笔属于 E 轮的一部分，不重复计入轮次总额。

amount_text: $2B at $87.20/share, nearly doubling Nvidia's ~6.3% stake
title_en: Nvidia invests $2B more in CoreWeave
title_zh: 英伟达再向 CoreWeave 投资 20 亿美元
summary_en: Nvidia bought $2B of CoreWeave stock at $87.20 a share, nearly doubling its stake, and agreed to help CoreWeave secure land and power toward more than 5 GW of capacity by 2030. Bloomberg called it the latest circular deal in AI.
summary_zh: 英伟达以每股 87.20 美元买入 20 亿美元 CoreWeave 股票，持股接近翻倍，并同意协助 CoreWeave 获取土地和电力，力争 2030 年前建成逾 5 吉瓦容量。彭博称之为 AI 领域最新的循环交易。

amount_text: 15% stake; price undisclosed; deal values TikTok US at ~$14B per Axios
title_en: MGX takes 15% of TikTok US joint venture
title_zh: MGX 持有 TikTok 美国合资公司 15% 股权
summary_en: Abu Dhabi's MGX became one of three 15% managing investors, alongside Oracle and Silver Lake, in the TikTok US joint venture carved out of ByteDance, which keeps 19.9%.
summary_zh: 阿布扎比 MGX 与甲骨文、银湖一起，成为从字节跳动分拆出的 TikTok 美国合资公司的三家各持 15% 的管理投资方，字节保留 19.9%。

amount_text: 15% stake; price undisclosed; deal values TikTok US at ~$14B per Axios
title_en: Oracle takes 15% of TikTok US joint venture
title_zh: 甲骨文持有 TikTok 美国合资公司 15% 股权
summary_en: ByteDance's TikTok US business moved into a joint venture closed on 22 January 2026 in which Oracle, Silver Lake and MGX each hold 15% as managing investors and ByteDance keeps 19.9%. Oracle also hosts TikTok US data.
summary_zh: 字节跳动将 TikTok 美国业务转入合资公司，交易于 2026 年 1 月 22 日完成，甲骨文、银湖和 MGX 作为管理投资方各持 15%，字节保留 19.9%。甲骨文同时承担 TikTok 美国数据的托管。

amount_text: Warrant for up to 33,445,026 Cerebras shares at $0.00001; 10,033,508 exercised Jul 2026 (~4.2%)
title_en: OpenAI warrant and stake in Cerebras
title_zh: OpenAI 持有 Cerebras 认股权证及股份
summary_en: Cerebras issued OpenAI a warrant for up to about 33.4 million shares, vesting with the working-capital loan, capacity delivery and market-cap milestones. OpenAI exercised about 10 million vested shares in July 2026, roughly a 4.2% stake.
summary_zh: Cerebras 向 OpenAI 发行最多约 3340 万股认股权证，随营运资金贷款发放、算力交付及市值里程碑归属。OpenAI 于 2026 年 7 月行使约 1000 万股已归属权证，持股约 4.2%。

amount_text: Alibaba's amount undisclosed; IPO raised ~HK$4.8B (~$620M) per Reuters (HK$5.54B with the greenshoe per TechNode)
title_en: Alibaba is cornerstone investor in MiniMax Hong Kong IPO
title_zh: 阿里巴巴作为基石投资者认购 MiniMax 港股 IPO
summary_en: Alibaba was a cornerstone investor, with ADIA, Boyu Capital and Mirae Asset, in MiniMax's Hong Kong IPO, which priced at HK$165 and listed on 9 January 2026.
summary_zh: 阿里巴巴与阿布扎比投资局、博裕资本、未来资产等作为基石投资者认购 MiniMax 香港 IPO，发行价 165 港元，于 2026 年 1 月 9 日上市。

amount_text: $500M (half of a $1B joint investment with SoftBank); valuation undisclosed
title_en: OpenAI invests $500M in Stargate partner SB Energy
title_zh: OpenAI 向星际之门合作方 SB Energy 投资 5 亿美元
summary_en: OpenAI and SoftBank each put $500M into SB Energy, which will build and operate OpenAI's 1.2 GW Stargate site in Milam County, Texas, under a non-exclusive preferred partnership.
summary_zh: OpenAI 与软银各向 SB Energy 投资 5 亿美元。SB Energy 将建设并运营 OpenAI 位于得州米拉姆县的 1.2 吉瓦星际之门站点，双方为非独家优先合作关系。

amount_text: HK$4,817.6M gross (~$619M): 29,197,600 Class A shares at HK$165, net ~HK$4,596M; the 4,379,640-share over-allotment was later exercised in full (net ~HK$697M more)
title_en: MiniMax raises HK$4.82B (~$619M) in Hong Kong IPO
title_zh: MiniMax 港股 IPO 募资 48.2 亿港元（约 6.19 亿美元）
summary_en: MiniMax listed in Hong Kong on 9 January 2026, a day after Zhipu, pricing 29.2 million Class A shares at the top of its HK$151-165 range; the retail tranche was over 1,800 times subscribed and the shares closed their first day up 109% at HK$345. Alibaba's cornerstone subscription is a separate edge.
summary_zh: MiniMax 于 2026 年 1 月 9 日（智谱上市次日）在港交所上市，以 151–165 港元区间上限定价发行 2920 万股 A 类股；公开发售超额认购逾 1800 倍，首日收报 345 港元、涨 109%。阿里巴巴的基石认购另有一条边。

amount_text: $500M (half of a $1B joint investment with OpenAI)
title_en: SoftBank puts $500M more into SB Energy for Stargate Texas
title_zh: 软银再向 SB Energy 注资 5 亿美元支持得州星际之门
summary_en: SoftBank matched OpenAI's $500M investment in its SB Energy unit, which is developing the 1.2 GW Stargate data-centre campus in Milam County, Texas, for OpenAI.
summary_zh: 软银与 OpenAI 同额向旗下 SB Energy 投资 5 亿美元；SB Energy 正为 OpenAI 开发得州米拉姆县 1.2 吉瓦星际之门数据中心园区。

subkind: initial public offering (Hong Kong H shares)
amount_text: HK$4.35B gross (~$558M): 37,419,500 H shares at HK$116.20; the 5,623,900-share over-allotment was exercised in full on 4 Feb 2026 (a further ~HK$654M), total net proceeds ~HK$4,896M
title_en: Zhipu AI raises HK$4.35B in Hong Kong IPO, the first listed LLM developer
title_zh: 智谱 AI 港股 IPO 募资 43.5 亿港元，成首家上市大模型公司
summary_en: Zhipu (Knowledge Atlas, since renamed Z.ai) listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on 8 January 2026 as stock code 2513, selling 37.4 million H shares at HK$116.20; the Hong Kong public tranche was about 1,160 times subscribed and eleven cornerstone investors took just under HK$3B. About 70% of proceeds go to model R&D. Zhipu is on the US Entity List.
summary_zh: 智谱（北京智谱华章，后更名 Z.ai）于 2026 年 1 月 8 日以股票代码 2513 在港交所上市，以每股 116.20 港元发行 3742 万股 H 股；香港公开发售超额认购约 1160 倍，11 家基石投资者认购近 30 亿港元。约七成募资用于模型研发。智谱已被列入美国实体清单。

amount_text: Undisclosed; Bloomberg reported up to $2B; part of xAI's $20B Series E
title_en: Nvidia invests in xAI's $20B Series E
title_zh: 英伟达参与 xAI 200 亿美元 E 轮融资
summary_en: xAI closed a $20B Series E with Nvidia and Cisco as strategic investors; Bloomberg had reported Nvidia would put in up to $2B, with much of the round's debt raised through an SPV that buys Nvidia GPUs to lease to xAI. xAI was merged into SpaceX weeks later.
summary_zh: xAI 完成 200 亿美元 E 轮融资，英伟达和思科为战略投资者；彭博此前报道英伟达出资最多 20 亿美元，该轮大部分债务通过一家购买英伟达 GPU 再租给 xAI 的特殊目的实体筹集。数周后 xAI 并入 SpaceX。

amount_text: $20B upsized Series E (target was $15B); Nvidia's share is a separate edge
title_en: xAI raises $20B Series E
title_zh: xAI 完成 200 亿美元 E 轮融资
summary_en: xAI raised an upsized $20B Series E from Valor, StepStone, Fidelity, QIA, MGX and Baron, with Nvidia and Cisco as strategic investors.
summary_zh: xAI 完成超额认购的 200 亿美元 E 轮融资（目标 150 亿美元），投资方包括 Valor、StepStone、富达、卡塔尔投资局、MGX 和 Baron，英伟达和思科为战略投资者。

amount_text: $500M at $4.3B valuation; IDG Capital led with $150M; Alibaba and Tencent took part
title_en: Moonshot AI $500M Series C
title_zh: 月之暗面 5 亿美元 C 轮融资
summary_en: Moonshot AI closed a $500M Series C led by IDG Capital, with existing backers Alibaba and Tencent participating, valuing it at $4.3B.
summary_zh: 月之暗面完成 5 亿美元 C 轮融资，由 IDG 资本领投，老股东阿里巴巴和腾讯跟投，估值 43 亿美元。

amount_text: Undisclosed; reported above $2B (WSJ), $2-3B per Reuters sources. Closed 29 Dec 2025 per Manus; China ordered the deal unwound on 27 Apr 2026
title_en: Meta acquires AI agent startup Manus
title_zh: Meta 收购 AI 智能体初创公司 Manus
summary_en: Meta agreed on 29 December 2025 to buy Manus, the Singapore-based AI agent startup with Chinese roots, for a reported $2B-plus, and the deal closed the same day. China's Ministry of Commerce opened a review in January 2026, and on 27 April 2026 the NDRC-led foreign-investment security review prohibited the acquisition and ordered the parties to unwind it; Manus said it would operate independently again, while Meta said the transaction complied with applicable law.
summary_zh: Meta 于 2025 年 12 月 29 日同意收购总部位于新加坡、具有中国背景的 AI 智能体初创公司 Manus，据报价格超过 20 亿美元，交易当日完成交割。中国商务部于 2026 年 1 月启动审查，2026 年 4 月 27 日由国家发改委牵头的外商投资安全审查禁止该收购并责令双方解除交易；Manus 表示将恢复独立运营，Meta 则称交易符合适用法律。

amount_text: $4.75B cash plus assumed debt; Intersect's existing Texas and California operating assets excluded and kept by current investors as a separate company
title_en: Alphabet buys data-centre power developer Intersect for $4.75B
title_zh: Alphabet 以 47.5 亿美元收购数据中心电力开发商 Intersect
summary_en: Alphabet agreed to acquire Intersect, a developer of co-located power and data-centre campuses, for $4.75B in cash plus debt; the deal closed on 10 March 2026.
summary_zh: Alphabet 同意以 47.5 亿美元现金加承担债务收购电源与数据中心一体化园区开发商 Intersect；交易于 2026 年 3 月 10 日完成。

amount_text: $1B equity stake (some reports add warrants for more shares); paired with a 3-year character licence for Sora
title_en: Disney invests $1B in OpenAI and licenses characters to Sora
title_zh: 迪士尼向 OpenAI 投资 10 亿美元并授权角色用于 Sora
summary_en: Disney is taking a $1B equity stake in OpenAI and licensing more than 200 Disney, Marvel, Pixar and Star Wars characters to Sora and ChatGPT Images for three years; Disney also becomes a major OpenAI API customer. At announcement the deal was subject to final agreements and approvals.
summary_zh: 迪士尼将入股 OpenAI 10 亿美元，并把 200 多个迪士尼、漫威、皮克斯和星球大战角色授权给 Sora 和 ChatGPT 图像功能使用三年，同时成为 OpenAI API 的大客户。公布时交易仍需最终协议和批准。

amount_text: Undisclosed; fund targets $10B of equity, $5B committed at launch by Brookfield, Nvidia, KIA and others; up to $100B of assets with co-investment and debt
title_en: Nvidia joins Brookfield's $100B AI infrastructure programme
title_zh: 英伟达加入布鲁克菲尔德 1000 亿美元 AI 基础设施计划
summary_en: Nvidia and the Kuwait Investment Authority joined as founding investors in the Brookfield Artificial Intelligence Infrastructure Fund, which aims to buy up to $100B of AI assets across energy, land, data centres and compute.
summary_zh: 英伟达与科威特投资局作为创始投资者加入布鲁克菲尔德人工智能基础设施基金，该基金计划收购最高 1000 亿美元覆盖能源、土地、数据中心和算力的 AI 资产。

amount_text: Up to $5B
title_en: Microsoft to invest up to $5B in Anthropic
title_zh: 微软向 Anthropic 投资最多 50 亿美元
summary_en: Microsoft committed up to $5B to Anthropic as part of the Azure deal; Anthropic said its February 2026 Series G included a portion of this previously announced investment.
summary_zh: 微软在 Azure 合作中承诺向 Anthropic 投资最多 50 亿美元；Anthropic 表示其 2026 年 2 月 G 轮融资包含了该笔已宣布投资的一部分。

amount_text: Up to $10B
title_en: Nvidia to invest up to $10B in Anthropic
title_zh: 英伟达向 Anthropic 投资最多 100 亿美元
summary_en: Nvidia committed up to $10B to Anthropic alongside a new engineering partnership, while Anthropic committed to compute on Nvidia systems. Anthropic said part of it was included in its February 2026 Series G.
summary_zh: 英伟达承诺向 Anthropic 投资最多 100 亿美元并建立工程合作，Anthropic 则承诺使用英伟达系统算力。Anthropic 表示其中部分资金已计入 2026 年 2 月 G 轮融资。

amount_text: ~$265M in cash, subject to purchase price adjustments; agreed October 2025 (day not given), disclosed 2025-11-05
title_en: Arm buys AI networking chipmaker DreamBig for $265M
title_zh: Arm 以 2.65 亿美元收购 AI 网络芯片商 DreamBig
summary_en: Arm agreed in October 2025 to buy 100% of DreamBig Semiconductor, maker of AI networking chiplets and SuperNICs, for about $265M in cash, disclosed with its November 2025 results; the deal closed on 1 July 2026.
summary_zh: Arm 于 2025 年 10 月同意以约 2.65 亿美元现金收购 AI 网络小芯片和超级网卡厂商 DreamBig 的全部股权，并在 2025 年 11 月财报中披露；交易于 2026 年 7 月 1 日完成。

amount_text: ~$7B cash contributed by Blue Owl funds for 80% of the JV (Meta keeps 20% and received a ~$3B one-time distribution); total development cost ~$27B
term: JV owns the Hyperion campus; Meta leases it on 4-year initial terms with extensions
title_en: Blue Owl funds take an 80% stake in Meta's Hyperion data-centre JV
title_zh: Blue Owl 基金入股 Meta Hyperion 数据中心合资公司 80%
summary_en: Blue Owl-managed funds hold 80% of the joint venture that owns Meta's Hyperion campus in Louisiana, having put in about $7B of cash; Meta kept 20% and took a one-time distribution of about $3B. The JV's bonds and Meta's lease are separate edges.
summary_zh: Blue Owl 管理的基金持有 Meta 路易斯安那州 Hyperion 园区合资公司 80% 股权，出资约 70 亿美元现金；Meta 保留 20% 并获得约 30 亿美元一次性分配。该合资公司的债券和 Meta 的租约另列。

from_name: AI Infrastructure Partnership (BlackRock, GIP, MGX, Microsoft, NVIDIA)
amount_text: ~$40B enterprise value; closed 21 Jul 2026, plus a further $5B growth-capital commitment by the consortium
title_en: BlackRock-led AI Infrastructure Partnership to buy Aligned Data Centers (~$40B)
title_zh: 贝莱德牵头的 AI 基础设施合作伙伴关系（AIP）以约 400 亿美元收购 Aligned 数据中心
summary_en: The AI Infrastructure Partnership (BlackRock/GIP and MGX, with Microsoft and NVIDIA) agreed in October 2025 to buy Aligned Data Centers from Macquarie Asset Management for about $40B, its first deal. The acquisition of 100% of Aligned's equity closed on 21 July 2026, and the consortium committed a further $5B of growth capital for Aligned's expansion (51 campuses, over 6.4 GW operational and planned).
summary_zh: AI 基础设施合作伙伴关系（AIP，贝莱德/GIP 与 MGX，微软和英伟达参与）于 2025 年 10 月同意以约 400 亿美元从麦格理资产管理收购 Aligned 数据中心，为其首笔交易。收购 Aligned 全部股权于 2026 年 7 月 21 日完成，财团另承诺 50 亿美元增长资本用于 Aligned 扩张（51 个园区，运营及规划容量逾 6.4 吉瓦）。

amount_text: Warrant for up to 160M AMD shares (~10%) at $0.01, vesting with GW deployed and AMD share-price milestones
term: Vests in tranches from first 1 GW to 6 GW
title_en: AMD grants OpenAI warrant for up to 160M shares
title_zh: AMD 向 OpenAI 授予最多 1.6 亿股认股权证
summary_en: As part of the GPU deal AMD issued OpenAI a warrant for up to 160 million AMD shares at one cent each, vesting as deployments scale to 6 GW and as AMD's share price hits targets. It is a circular structure: the buyer can end up owning about a tenth of its supplier.
summary_zh: 作为 GPU 协议的一部分，AMD 向 OpenAI 发行可按每股 0.01 美元认购最多 1.6 亿股的认股权证，随部署规模扩大至 6 吉瓦及 AMD 股价达标分批归属。这是典型的循环结构：买方最终可能持有供应商约一成股份。

amount_text: CNY 3.985B (~$560M at ~7.11 CNY/USD) at CNY 1,195.02/share to 13 investors incl. GF Fund (CNY 1.208B), UBS AG, New China Asset
title_en: Cambricon CNY 3.99B private placement for large-model chips
title_zh: 寒武纪 39.85 亿元人民币定增投向大模型芯片
summary_en: Cambricon raised CNY 3.985B from 13 institutional investors to fund a chip platform and a software platform for large AI models, plus working capital. The new shares were registered on 16 October 2025.
summary_zh: 寒武纪向 13 家机构定增募资 39.85 亿元人民币，用于面向大模型的芯片平台和软件平台项目及补充流动资金；新增股份于 2025 年 10 月 16 日完成登记。

amount_text: Up to $100B, tied to each GW of 10 GW deployed; a maximum that was never committed (cancelled, so not in totals)
term: Staged as each gigawatt deploys, first phase H2 2026
title_en: Nvidia letter of intent to invest up to $100B in OpenAI (superseded)
title_zh: 英伟达拟向 OpenAI 投资最多 1000 亿美元的意向书（已被取代）
summary_en: Nvidia and OpenAI signed a letter of intent for at least 10 GW of Nvidia systems, with Nvidia investing up to $100B as capacity came online. Nvidia's CFO said in December 2025 it had not gone past the LOI stage, and in February 2026 it was replaced by a $30B equity investment with no deployment milestones.
summary_zh: 英伟达与 OpenAI 签署意向书，计划部署至少 10 吉瓦英伟达系统，英伟达随算力上线分阶段投资最多 1000 亿美元。英伟达首席财务官 2025 年 12 月表示该协议仍停留在意向书阶段；2026 年 2 月被一笔不附带部署里程碑的 300 亿美元股权投资取代。

title_en: Nvidia invests $5B in Intel
title_zh: 英伟达向英特尔投资 50 亿美元
summary_en: Nvidia agreed to buy $5B of Intel stock at $23.28 a share as the two co-develop custom data-centre CPUs and RTX-equipped PC chips; the purchase closed in late December 2025 after US antitrust clearance.
summary_zh: 英伟达同意以每股 23.28 美元买入 50 亿美元英特尔股票，双方共同开发定制数据中心 CPU 及集成 RTX 的 PC 芯片；该交易在获美国反垄断批准后于 2025 年 12 月底完成。

amount_text: $750M at a $6.9B post-money valuation, led by Disruptive with BlackRock, Neuberger Berman, DTCP; Samsung, Cisco and others participated
title_en: Groq raises $750M at $6.9B valuation
title_zh: Groq 融资 7.5 亿美元，估值 69 亿美元
summary_en: AI inference-chip maker Groq raised $750M at a $6.9B post-money valuation, led by Disruptive, to expand its data-centre capacity, three months before Nvidia's licensing and acqui-hire deal.
summary_zh: AI 推理芯片公司 Groq 完成由 Disruptive 领投的 7.5 亿美元融资，投后估值 69 亿美元，用于扩充数据中心容量；三个月后英伟达与其达成技术授权和人才收购协议。

amount_text: €1.3B (~$1.5B) of a €1.7B Series C; ~11% fully diluted stake; ~€11.7B post-money
title_en: ASML leads Mistral AI's Series C with €1.3B
title_zh: 阿斯麦以 13 亿欧元领投 Mistral AI C 轮
summary_en: ASML invested €1.3B as lead investor of Mistral AI's €1.7B Series C, taking about 11% and a seat on its Strategic Committee, alongside a partnership to use Mistral models across ASML's products and R&D.
summary_zh: 阿斯麦作为领投方向 Mistral AI 17 亿欧元的 C 轮投入 13 亿欧元，获得约 11% 股权及战略委员会席位，并达成在其产品与研发中使用 Mistral 模型的合作。

amount_text: $13.0B of Series F-1 shares at $140.97 a share, sold August-September 2025 ($183B post-money; Anthropic S-1)
title_en: Anthropic $13B Series F at $183B
title_zh: Anthropic 130 亿美元 F 轮融资（估值 1830 亿美元）
summary_en: Anthropic raised $13B led by ICONIQ, co-led by Fidelity and Lightspeed, at a $183B post-money valuation.
summary_zh: Anthropic 完成 130 亿美元 F 轮融资，由 ICONIQ 领投、富达与 Lightspeed 联合领投，投后估值 1830 亿美元。

to_name: Chirisa Technology Parks (Blue Owl JV partner)
amount_text: $4B JV funding (Blue Owl funds, Chirisa Technology Parks affiliates, Machine Investment Group)
title_en: Blue Owl-led $4B JV funds CoreWeave's Lancaster campus
title_zh: Blue Owl 牵头的 40 亿美元合资为 CoreWeave 兰开斯特园区融资
summary_en: Blue Owl funds, Chirisa Technology Parks affiliates and Machine Investment Group closed a JV with $4B of funding for the CoreWeave-leased AI campus in Lancaster, Pennsylvania.
summary_zh: Blue Owl 基金、Chirisa 科技园关联方与 Machine Investment Group 完成合资，为 CoreWeave 承租的宾夕法尼亚州兰开斯特 AI 园区提供 40 亿美元资金。

amount_text: $8.9B for 433.3M shares at $20.47 (~9.9%): $5.7B of unpaid CHIPS grants + $3.2B Secure Enclave; plus a 5-year warrant for 5% more at $20 if Intel's foundry stake falls below 51%
title_en: US government takes a 9.9% stake in Intel for $8.9B
title_zh: 美国政府以 89 亿美元入股英特尔 9.9%
summary_en: The US government converted Intel's remaining CHIPS Act and Secure Enclave grants into an $8.9B purchase of Intel common stock, a passive 9.9% stake; the Secure Enclave portion is paid as milestones are met.
summary_zh: 美国政府将英特尔尚未拨付的芯片法案及“安全飞地”补贴转为 89 亿美元的英特尔普通股认购，持股约 9.9%（被动持股）；安全飞地部分按里程碑拨付。

amount_text: $2B of new Intel common stock at $23 a share
title_en: SoftBank invests $2B in Intel
title_zh: 软银向英特尔投资 20 亿美元
summary_en: SoftBank signed a definitive agreement to buy $2B of newly issued Intel shares at $23 each; Intel's Q3 2025 results reported the investment as made.
summary_zh: 软银签署最终协议，以每股 23 美元认购 20 亿美元英特尔新股；英特尔 2025 年第三季度财报确认该投资已完成。

amount_text: Price undisclosed; plus new capital to the land fund to develop 650 MW in Chicago, Atlanta and Dallas
title_en: Apollo funds to buy majority of Stream Data Centers
title_zh: 阿波罗基金收购 Stream 数据中心多数股权
summary_en: Apollo-managed funds agreed to buy a majority stake in hyperscale developer Stream Data Centers from Stream Realty Partners, management keeping a minority stake; closing was expected in 2025 (not confirmed here).
summary_zh: 阿波罗管理的基金同意从 Stream Realty Partners 收购超大规模数据中心开发商 Stream 数据中心的多数股权，管理层保留少数股权；预计 2025 年交割（此处未核实是否已完成）。

amount_text: ~$9B all-stock; terminated, so not counted in totals
title_en: CoreWeave's $9B bid for Core Scientific (terminated)

title_zh: Meta 入股 Scale AI 49%

title_en: Blue Owl co-sponsors Crusoe's $15B Abilene campus joint venture
title_zh: Blue Owl 联合投资 Crusoe 阿比林园区 150 亿美元合资项目

amount_text: ~$6.5B all-stock; OpenAI already held ~23% and paid ~$5B of shares for the rest (announced 2025-05-21, closed 2025-07-09)
title_en: OpenAI buys Jony Ive's io for $6.5B in stock
title_zh: OpenAI 以约 65 亿美元股票收购乔尼·艾维的 io
summary_en: OpenAI bought io, the AI-device startup co-founded by former Apple design chief Jony Ive, in an all-stock deal of nearly $6.5B, its largest acquisition, to build its own hardware. The deal closed on 9 July 2025.
summary_zh: OpenAI 以近 65 亿美元全股票方式收购前苹果首席设计师乔尼·艾维联合创办的 AI 设备公司 io，这是其迄今最大收购，用于自研硬件；交易于 2025 年 7 月 9 日完成。

title_zh: MGX 联合创立法国 AI 园区（欧洲最大 AI 园区）

summary_zh: MGX、Bpifrance、Mistral AI 与英伟达在“选择法国”峰会上宣布组建合资公司，在巴黎地区建设 1.4 吉瓦 AI 园区，Mistral 享有算力优先使用权。

title_zh: Mistral AI 联合创立法国 AI 园区合资公司
summary_en: Mistral AI is a partner, with MGX, Bpifrance and Nvidia, in the joint venture building the 1.4 GW Campus AI in the Paris region, which will host its compute.
summary_zh: Mistral AI 与 MGX、Bpifrance 和英伟达共同参与在巴黎地区建设 1.4 吉瓦法国 AI 园区的合资公司，该园区将承载其算力。

subkind: equity investment (co-investors in a SoftBank-led round)
amount_text: ~$10B syndicated to co-investors (Microsoft, Coatue, Altimeter, Thrive) in the $40B round led by SoftBank's $30B; SoftBank later put the aggregate at $41B; SoftBank's $30B is softbank-openai-2025-03-equity
title_en: Co-investors put ~$10B into OpenAI's March 2025 round
title_zh: 跟投方向 OpenAI 2025 年 3 月融资轮出资约 100 亿美元
summary_en: Alongside SoftBank's $30B lead, a syndicate including Microsoft, Coatue, Altimeter and Thrive committed about $10B to OpenAI's $40B round at a $300B post-money valuation announced on 31 March 2025; CNBC reported in December 2025 that the round was fully funded at an aggregate $41B. Individual amounts were not disclosed.
summary_zh: 在软银领投 300 亿美元之外，微软、Coatue、Altimeter 和 Thrive 等跟投方向 OpenAI 2025 年 3 月 31 日宣布的 400 亿美元融资（投后估值 3000 亿美元）承诺约 100 亿美元；CNBC 2025 年 12 月报道该轮已全部到位，合计 410 亿美元。各家出资额未披露。

amount_text: $30B from SoftBank ($7.5B Apr 2025 + $22.5B Dec 2025) in a $41B round; the ~$10-11B co-investor piece is its own edge (private-investors-openai-2025-03-round)
title_en: SoftBank leads OpenAI's $41B round
title_zh: 软银领投 OpenAI 410 亿美元融资
summary_en: SoftBank led OpenAI's March 2025 round, investing $7.5B in April and $22.5B in December 2025 through Vision Fund 2, with $11B from co-investors. SoftBank said the round was fully funded on 26 December 2025, giving it about 11% of OpenAI.
summary_zh: 软银领投 OpenAI 2025 年 3 月的融资，通过愿景基金二期于 4 月出资 75 亿美元、12 月出资 225 亿美元，另有 110 亿美元来自跟投方。软银称该轮已于 2025 年 12 月 26 日全部到位，持有 OpenAI 约 11% 股份。

title_en: Anthropic $3.5B Series E at $61.5B
title_zh: Anthropic 35 亿美元 E 轮融资（估值 615 亿美元）

summary_zh: Anthropic 于 2025 年 1-3 月以 E-1 优先股融资约 35.7 亿美元，由 Lightspeed 领投，Bessemer、思科、D1、富达、General Catalyst、Jane Street、Menlo 和 Salesforce Ventures 参投，资金用于算力、研究和国际扩张。

title_en: Google invests another $1B in Anthropic
title_zh: 谷歌再向 Anthropic 投资 10 亿美元
summary_en: The Financial Times reported that Google was investing a further $1B or more in Anthropic, taking its total past $3B; CNBC confirmed through a source.
summary_zh: 据《金融时报》报道，谷歌再向 Anthropic 投资约 10 亿美元或更多，使其累计投资超过 30 亿美元；CNBC 通过消息人士予以证实。

summary_zh: 星际之门项目是为 OpenAI 在美国建设 AI 基础设施的新公司，初始股权出资方为软银、OpenAI、甲骨文和 MGX；MGX 为阿布扎比 AI 投资公司。

title_zh: 谷歌在 8 亿美元融资中入股 Intersect Power
summary_en: Google joined TPG Rise Climate, Climate Adaptive Infrastructure and Greenbelt Capital in an $800M+ funding of Intersect Power, under a partnership to build data-centre parks co-located with new clean power, with Google as anchor tenant. Google later bought the company (separate edge).
summary_zh: 谷歌与 TPG Rise Climate、Climate Adaptive Infrastructure 及 Greenbelt Capital 一起参与 Intersect Power 逾 8 亿美元的融资，双方合作建设与新清洁电源同址的数据中心园区，谷歌为主力租户；谷歌后来收购了该公司（另列一条）。

title_zh: OpenAI 以 1570 亿美元估值融资 66 亿美元

title_zh: 黑石以 240 亿澳元收购 AirTrunk
summary_en: A Blackstone-led consortium including CPP Investments bought Australian data-centre operator AirTrunk at an enterprise value of about A$24B, billed as the largest data-centre deal globally; it closed in December 2024 after regulatory approvals.
summary_zh: 黑石牵头、加拿大养老基金投资公司参与的财团以约 240 亿澳元的企业价值收购澳大利亚数据中心运营商 AirTrunk，被称为全球最大的数据中心交易，于 2024 年 12 月获监管批准后完成。

title_zh: Blue Owl、Chirisa 与 PowerHouse 为 CoreWeave 设立数据中心合资

summary_zh: Blue Owl、Chirisa 科技园与 PowerHouse 数据中心组建合作，可投入最高约 50 亿美元建设 AI 和高性能计算数据中心，首期为 Chirisa 里士满附近园区、为 CoreWeave 交付的 120 兆瓦。

summary_zh: Mistral AI 以约 58 亿欧元估值融资约 6 亿欧元，由 General Catalyst 领投，现有风投及英伟达、三星等企业投资者参与。

summary_zh: 阿波罗旗下基金投资 110 亿美元，取得英特尔爱尔兰莱克斯利普 Fab 34 相关合资企业 49% 股权；英特尔保留 51% 股权和运营控制权。

summary_zh: 阿里巴巴领投上海 AI 初创公司 MiniMax 至少 6 亿美元的融资，估值超过 25 亿美元，红杉中国（HongShan，原红杉资本中国基金）也承诺跟投，老股东包括腾讯和 IDG 资本。

title_zh: 阿里巴巴领投月之暗面 10 亿美元融资

amount_text: $8B in convertible notes: up to $4B under the Sept 2023 agreement ($1.2B Sept 2023 + $2.8B of proceeds in Mar 2024) and $4B under the Nov 2024 agreement ($1.3B Nov 2024, $1.3B May 2025, $1.4B Nov 2025). Part converted into non-voting preferred shares; ~$6.2B of non-interest rollover notes remained at 30 June 2026 because of Amazon's 12% ownership cap, converting at the IPO (Anthropic S-1)
title_en: Amazon's $8B investment in Anthropic
title_zh: 亚马逊对 Anthropic 的 80 亿美元投资
summary_en: Amazon invested $8B in Anthropic through convertible notes under 2023 and 2024 agreements, the last tranche funded in November 2025; notes that could not convert under Amazon's 12% ownership cap were reissued as interest-free rollover notes (~$6.2B at 30 June 2026). AWS became Anthropic's primary cloud and training partner, using Trainium chips.
summary_zh: 亚马逊依据 2023 年和 2024 年协议，以可转换票据方式向 Anthropic 投资 80 亿美元，最后一笔于 2025 年 11 月到位；因亚马逊 12% 持股上限而无法转股的部分改为无息展期票据（2026 年 6 月 30 日约 62 亿美元）。AWS 成为 Anthropic 主要云和训练合作方，使用 Trainium 芯片。

amount_text: $2.0B of 10% convertible notes in three tranches: $500M (Sept 2023), $750M (Sept 2024), $750M (Sept 2025); all converted into non-voting preferred shares by January 2026 (Anthropic S-1). Agreement dated September 2023, day not disclosed
term: Notes due 48 months after each issue; converted
title_en: Google's $2B convertible-note investment in Anthropic
title_zh: 谷歌以可转换票据向 Anthropic 投资 20 亿美元
summary_en: Under a September 2023 note purchase agreement Google lent Anthropic $2B in convertible notes, funded in three tranches through September 2025; the notes converted into non-voting Series E and Series G-4 preferred shares, the last in January 2026. Anthropic also has a commercial agreement with Google.
summary_zh: 根据 2023 年 9 月的票据购买协议，谷歌以可转换票据形式向 Anthropic 提供 20 亿美元，分三批于 2025 年 9 月前到位；票据已转为无投票权的 E 轮及 G-4 优先股，最后一批于 2026 年 1 月转换。Anthropic 与谷歌另有商业合作协议。

summary_zh: CoreWeave 2023 年 4 月的 B 轮融资由 Magnetar Capital 领投，英伟达、Nat Friedman 和 Daniel Gross 参投；英伟达的出资额未披露（Crain's Chicago Business 后来报道约为 1 亿美元）。这是英伟达首次持股 CoreWeave，也是供应商、投资者与客户三重循环的起点。

amount_text: $13B total funding commitments (2019-2023); ~27% stake worth ~$135B after Oct 2025 recap
title_en: Microsoft's ~27% stake in OpenAI
title_zh: 微软持有 OpenAI 约 27% 股权
summary_en: Microsoft disclosed $13B of total funding commitments to OpenAI ($1B in 2019, then multiyear rounds from 2021 and January 2023). In the October 2025 recapitalisation this became roughly 27% of OpenAI Group PBC on an as-converted diluted basis, valued at about $135B.
summary_zh: 微软披露向 OpenAI 的累计出资承诺为 130 亿美元（2019 年 10 亿美元，2021 年及 2023 年 1 月起多年期追加）。2025 年 10 月资本重组后，这部分权益转换为 OpenAI Group PBC 约 27% 的股份（按转换后完全稀释计），价值约 1350 亿美元。
